results.content: Shifting Support Among Key Voters The latest Economist/YouGov Poll released on August 11 shows the lowest net approval ratings Trump has received among women (-36), white Americans (-19) and college graduates (-42). Economic Concerns Heading Into the Midterms Americans continue identifying the economy as the most important issue facing the country—one that will remain top of mind as voters head to the ballot box come November. If not, “what could have been an incredibly successful midterm for the Republicans is up in the air… and that’s because the Democrats are so bad.” Contact Newsweek editors on this story: Anna Commander and Edward T.
